pr.title: R0006: qualify bounded native prayer recovery
pr.body:
Implements #6.

Completes the executable R0006 documentation and native qualification work on the delivered R0007/R0002/R0004 base. The accepted prayer lifecycle is unchanged: all 135 runtime files, nine accepted prayer-owner spans and five original regression suites remain current.

Candidate head: `f1d8a50cfcab75ce11ebaede90f427c1f935def6`.
Reviewed base: `c431733c57f76e2b441ee8f8cd85a1fa6675de55`.
Specification: `21e7a84365fae37a86cae5c7d5e41008c0adc53f:docs/rlgwo-execution/20261008/REMAINING_RLGWOs/R0006.md`.

The README clarifies the nominal 32.7-second timeout path and CPU/event-loop limits. Ten original native cases per engine reuse the existing Playwright driver and unchanged observation fixture. The only driver adaptations provide complete bounded trace export, native interval polling for observation waits, and an actual offscreen-card stimulus. No product scheduler, lifecycle, provider, cache schema or rendering code changes.

### Original acceptance matrix

| Acceptance | Evidence and disposition |
| --- | --- |
| 6.01–6.12, 6.14 | Accepted implementation preserved. Exact owner/runtime/test currentness verified; 72 original source tests pass, including deadline, cold-branch and cooldown mutation controls. |
| A01 / 6.13 | README covers three attempts, full asynchronous 10-second deadlines, 900/1800 ms backoffs, nominal 32.7 seconds plus scheduling, operation-start real-elapsed cooldown, valid-cache/tomorrow/visibility limits and no background/offline guarantee. |
| A02 / 6.15.a | Both native engines: three successful-header/unsettled-body attempts exhaust with no owned timer or stuck slot. Healthy current request four succeeds on the same civil day after the real 60-second fence. Hostile late bodies cannot alter the recovered timetable/cache or successor ownership. Loading, unavailable and first recovered native images retained. |
| A03 / 6.15.b | Both engines: actual card offscreen during cooldown, paused beyond 65 seconds, then one resumed recovery operation. Separate frozen/120x clock and generation/late-cleanup controls preserve real elapsed eligibility and ownership. No document-hidden success claim. |
| A04 / 6.15.c | Both engines: success on attempt three with no fourth; selected current cache survives offline refresh and denied writes; matching tomorrow suppresses redundant calls beyond 65 seconds, then actual day promotion permits the next legitimate acquisition. |
| A05 / 6.15.d | All selected first native cards show six rows, arc, next output, header and date footer. Root/offline/iframe and frozen V1 preserved. Original motion/preference/opaque-Moon qualification reused only with exact runtime/input/environment and 91-file identity. |
| A06 / 6.16.a | Independent read-only reconciliation of every original row, all 20 selected traces, native first images and predecessors, failed acquisitions, source/fixture identity and lossless artifact projection. Final-head/public readback follows publication. |
| A07 / 6.16.b | Reserved owner exact-head merge approval, then merged-tree/Pages/public-consumer readback, published and independently read-back CLOSE-R0006, completed issue closure and independent closed-state verification. This Draft PR does not satisfy A07. |

### Native timing and contrary evidence

In the cold case, Chromium's exhausted path was 32715.7 ms and Firefox's was 32716 ms from operation start. The fourth current request occurred at 60541.0 ms against a 60527.3 ms fence in Chromium, and at 60376 ms against a 60376 ms fence in Firefox. Each case contains **four low-level current attempts in two current operations**, plus a separate successful tomorrow-prefetch operation/attempt. Individual timer/backoff and scheduler delays are retained in the traces.

All 31 acquisitions are retained, including 11 failed, incomplete or superseded acquisitions. Both accelerated traces retain every original render receipt and decompress to their exact original bytes. Failed exports and observation fixtures remain visible. No later healthy frame replaces an incomplete first image.

Firefox functional videos include blank/partial captures. They receive bounded first-presentation and state-image qualification only, with **no continuous-readability or motion credit**. The distinct continuous-motion predicate comes from exact original qualified full-Chromium and headed-Firefox controls. Fresh Chromium functional cases use headless shell; Firefox promotion uses the explicitly bound headed/100 ms observation-polling variant. No OS or renderer/capturer causal claim is made.

### Reviewable packet and checks

- [Packet, currentness, timing and reproduction](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/f1d8a50cfcab75ce11ebaede90f427c1f935def6/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R0006/README.md)
- [All acquisition dispositions](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/f1d8a50cfcab75ce11ebaede90f427c1f935def6/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R0006/cases.json) and [exact artifact manifest](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/f1d8a50cfcab75ce11ebaede90f427c1f935def6/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R0006/manifest.json)
- [Independent A01–A06 review](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/f1d8a50cfcab75ce11ebaede90f427c1f935def6/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R0006/qualification/independent-review/final-review.md)
- [PRE_DELIVERY qualification certificate](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/f1d8a50cfcab75ce11ebaede90f427c1f935def6/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R0006/qualification/closure-certificate.json)

Validation: 72 source tests passed with no failure/skip/TODO; 20 selected native engine/case acquisitions independently qualified within their stated scope; compressed public traces pass the read-only verifier; original-byte decompression and manifest membership verified; Python syntax, frozen V1 and diff checks passed. Runtime unchanged. No unrelated whole-scene or astronomy qualification restarted.

Issue #6 intentionally remains open. No merge, deployment, CLOSE-R0006 or completed closure is claimed or authorized by this PR.
